Beagle.name: Beagle
Beagle.tagline: Curious, merry, and loving scent hound
Beagle.description: Beagles are compact, athletic hounds known for their extraordinary scent-tracking ability, cheerful disposition, and soulful brown eyes. They make wonderful family companions and thrive in active households.
Beagle.care_tips: Needs regular exercise and scent games to prevent boredom. Keep on a leash outside securely fenced areas.
Beagle.fun_fact: Beagles have over 220 million scent receptors, making them top airport detection dogs around the world!

Chihuahua.name: Chihuahua
Chihuahua.tagline: Tiny dog with a huge personality and devoted heart
Chihuahua.description: Chihuahuas are the smallest dog breed in the world, renowned for their big, expressive eyes, alert demeanor, and charmingly sassy personality. Fiercely loyal to their humans, they are lively and affectionate companions.
Chihuahua.care_tips: Keep warm in chilly weather with sweaters. Handle gently and provide early socialization.
Chihuahua.fun_fact: Chihuahuas are named after the Mexican state of Chihuahua, where they were discovered in the mid-19th century.

English_Setter.name: English Setter
English_Setter.tagline: The gentleman of the dog world with feathered elegance
English_Setter.description: English Setters are graceful sporting dogs recognized by their distinctive speckled 'belton' coat and elegant feathered tail. They combine hunting athleticism with a sweet, affectionate, and mild home temperament.
English_Setter.care_tips: Regular brushing is essential to maintain their silky coat and avoid tangles. Requires regular open-space exercise.
English_Setter.fun_fact: Their unique speckled coat pattern is known exclusively as 'belton', named after a town in England.

Golden_Retriever.name: Golden Retriever
Golden_Retriever.tagline: The quintessence of loyalty, joy, and gentle devotion
Golden_Retriever.description: Golden Retrievers are one of the most beloved breeds globally, cherished for their exuberant joy, high intelligence, and eager-to-please nature. They excel as family pets, therapy dogs, and service animals.
Golden_Retriever.care_tips: Brush their double coat several times a week. Provide both mental enrichment and physical workouts.
Golden_Retriever.fun_fact: They have 'soft mouths' bred to retrieve waterfowl undamaged—they can even carry a raw egg without cracking it!

Labrador_Retriever.name: Labrador Retriever
Labrador_Retriever.tagline: America's perennial favorite: friendly, versatile, and energetic
Labrador_Retriever.description: Labrador Retrievers are famously friendly, outgoing, and spirited companions. With their water-resistant coat and otter-like tail, they are passionate swimmers and natural athletes with huge hearts.
Labrador_Retriever.good_with: Families of all sizes, Kids & Other Pets
Labrador_Retriever.care_tips: Watch their diet as Labradors love food! Give them daily exercise like fetching or dock diving.
Labrador_Retriever.fun_fact: Labradors have webbed toes and water-repellent coats that help them glide effortlessly through water.

Miniature_Poodle.name: Miniature Poodle
Miniature_Poodle.tagline: Brainy, elegant, and exceptionally versatile athlete
Miniature_Poodle.description: Miniature Poodles rank among the most intelligent dog breeds in existence. Behind the stylish curls lies an eager learner, agile athlete, and loving companion with a low-shedding hypoallergenic coat.
Miniature_Poodle.temperament: Highly intelligent, alert, playful, and responsive
Miniature_Poodle.energy_level: Medium to High (Excels at agility & puzzle toys)
Miniature_Poodle.care_tips: Requires regular professional clipping and daily combing to prevent mats in their non-shedding curls.
Miniature_Poodle.fun_fact: Despite their salon reputation, poodles were originally bred as tough water retrievers in duck hunting!

Pug.name: Pug
Pug.tagline: Charming, comical companion with a wrinkle of love
Pug.description: Pugs are renowned for their wrinkled brow, big soulful eyes, and curling tail. Bred as lapdogs for Chinese emperors, their lifelong mission is to love their human companions and make everyone smile.
Pug.energy_level: Low to Moderate (Short walks & couch cuddles)
Pug.care_tips: Clean facial wrinkles regularly with a damp cloth. Avoid strenuous exercise in hot humid weather.
Pug.fun_fact: A group of pugs is called a 'Grumble'! Their motto is 'Multum in Parvo' (a lot of dog in a small space).

Rottweiler.name: Rottweiler
Rottweiler.tagline: Powerful protector with a gentle, loyal soul for family
Rottweiler.description: Rottweilers are robust, muscular working dogs descended from Roman drover dogs. Confident, calm, and courageously loyal, a properly trained Rottweiler is an affectionate and steadfast family protector.
Rottweiler.temperament: Confident, loyal, calm, courageous, and protective
Rottweiler.energy_level: Medium to High (Needs structured exercise & tasks)
Rottweiler.care_tips: Early obedience training and positive socialization are vital. Low grooming needs with short coat.
Rottweiler.fun_fact: In the Middle Ages, butchers kept their money in pouches tied around their Rottweilers' necks for safekeeping!

Shih_Tzu.name: Shih Tzu
Shih_Tzu.tagline: The royal lion dog blessed with sweet affection and charm
Shih_Tzu.description: Shih Tzus ('Lion Dogs') were pampered royal favorites in Chinese imperial courts for centuries. With their flowing coats and sweet temperament, they excel at sitting gracefully on laps and spreading joy.
Shih_Tzu.energy_level: Low to Moderate (Casual walks & gentle play)
Shih_Tzu.care_tips: Daily brushing required for long coats, or opt for a popular low-maintenance 'puppy cut'.
Shih_Tzu.fun_fact: Ancient Tibetan monks believed Shih Tzus were mini lions and spiritual protectors of monasteries.

Siberian_Husky.name: Siberian Husky
Siberian_Husky.tagline: Breathtaking beauty, arctic endurance, and free-spirited joy
Siberian_Husky.description: Siberian Huskies are legendary sled dogs with striking almond eyes, lush double coats, and boundless stamina. Friendly and talkative, they love pack life and outdoor adventures in cooler climates.
Siberian_Husky.energy_level: Very High (Needs ample daily running & exercise)
Siberian_Husky.care_tips: Requires a secure high fence (escape artists!). Heavy seasonal shedding requires thorough de-shedding.
Siberian_Husky.fun_fact: Huskies communicate with expressive howls and 'talking' vocalizations rather than standard barking!
